topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: I can't believe you're really doing this, moving all the way across the country! It's a huge deal, and I know it's got to be tough, but I also think it's amazing, you going after what you want like that. I’m going to miss you like crazy, but I'm all here, cheering you on, no matter the distance. We've been through so much together, and I know this is just another chapter, a big, exciting one. So, let's make the most of it, okay? Promise me we’ll keep in touch, more than ever. I’m here for you, always. Let’s make this an adventure, even if it's a little bittersweet.
